task: Expose durable audit queue progress, add preparation and report-building events, drive the existing modal from backend status, and update only the local Docker review.
nonGoals: Production or public Pages deployment, merging PRs, live model or browser-capture calls, billing/usage/CPU limit increases, credential or scoring-rule changes, rewriting existing branch history or evaluation checks.

outcomes.description: Authenticated audit responses expose bounded versioned progress from actual persisted queue and pipeline state, including preparation start/completion and score-card building start before final publication.
outcomes.evidence: Producer/status contract tests with queued, running, retry, skipped, failure, partial and terminal publication cases.

outcomes.description: Modal shows waiting, active, completed, skipped and failed states from backend progress without timers inventing completion, preserves the page/focus, and opens the report only when published. Legacy APIs remain indeterminate.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen progress fixtures, frontend render tests and local queue-to-modal browser verification.

outcomes.description: Password gate, retry idempotency and usage reservations remain enforced; no model calls or production mutations occur in testing/local review.
outcomes.evidence: Existing guard/queue regressions and deterministic local fixture harness using actual queue producer/consumer progress.

process.description: Commit plan before code, use Terra agents with separated scopes and independent review, run genuine source-bound checks and open a feature PR without merge/deploy.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluation traces, review and hosted CI. Feature branch base is queue backend ce27d19; retain required main-base command observation separately and use actual integration base for PR evidence.

styleEfficiency.description: Use a shared sanitized progress contract, bounded event writes covered by existing allowances, and reuse the reviewed modal/frontend. Keep original audit-progress branch and production unchanged.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Diff, event budget tests, browser proof and local container review.

exitTest.reason: This changes application queue status and modal presentation, not agent memory, portability, resumability or agent workflow. Existing genuine exit evidence is not reused and required exit smoke tests still run.
